L26n1317.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L26n1317.description: Mid-word pieces of rare or split names and words (e.g. 'Al|bre|cht', 'pter|od|actyl', 'Pavan|Put|ra'), peaking on the piece that finishes an unusual word; pushes the model toward 'debug' tokens.

L26n2797.name: Technical word-start fragments
L26n2797.description: Opening pieces of long technical words split into tokens (prim|ordial, nos|ocomial, Res|istor, Pert|uss|is), including 'specific' pieces; pushes the model toward 'spec' and 'spectrum'.

L26n2144.name: Word-start 'gu' and 'ang'
L26n2144.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, most often 'gu' (guillotine, guerrilla, guayule) or 'ang' (angina), plus some proper names (Dol|aucothi, Rod|inia); pushes toward 'dataset'.

L26n2245.name: Hyphen-compound second part
L26n2245.description: The short piece right after a hyphen in a compound (two-d|ose, free-d|ocking, heavy-g|auge, high-D|eductible); pushes toward 'patch'.

L26n1853.name: Articles before noun phrases
L26n1853.description: Articles and prepositions ('the', 'a', 'The', 'of', 'in') in dense prose, peaking where a noun phrase is about to start; pushes toward closing quotes and backticks (``, 」, 』).

L26n2962.name: 're-' and 'dis-' prefixes
L26n2962.description: The prefix piece 're' or 'dis' that opens a word split into tokens (re|claims, dis|use, well-re|searched, non-re|newable); pushes toward 'utility' and 'util' tokens.

L26n3003.name: 'res-'/'sm-' word starts
L26n3003.description: Word-opening pieces 'res', 'sm', 'rob' and 'exp' of split verbs and nouns (res|erve, res|ided, res|ettle, sm|og, rob|bers); pushes toward 'transaction'.

L26n2678.name: 'Ar' starts, X-ray/CT
L26n2678.description: The 'Ar' or 'ar' piece opening split words (Ar|terial, ar|thritis, Fossil Ar|chaeology, Donna Ar|nett) and '-ray' in x-ray text; pushes toward 'sensor'.

L26n2904.name: Proper-noun word starts
L26n2904.description: The first 1-3 letter piece of split proper nouns and rare words (Meg|iddo, Sel|aginellaceae, Sid|on, Sw|indon, Rou|en); pushes toward 'pipe'.

L26n1476.name: Stem before '-val'
L26n1476.description: Middle pieces of long split words that come just before a '-val' ending (medi|æ|val, re|trie|val), with weaker firing on other mid-word pieces (Siber|ia, Mill|an); pushes toward 'val'.

L26n1394.name: 'emb' and 'verte' starts
L26n1394.description: The 'emb' or 'verte' piece opening split words (emb|ark, verte|bral, embry|onic); pushes toward 'br' pieces, as in verte|br|ates.

L26n1703.name: 'Sh' word onset
L26n1703.description: The 'Sh' or 'sh' onset that opens a word (Sh|aped, sh|akshuka, Sh|irts, sh|ored, sh|roud), plus 'cre' and SQL 'BY'/'LIMIT'; pushes toward 'operator'.

L26n2037.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L26n2037.description: Word-internal onset fragments that start with a consonant cluster ('cl' in cl|ots, 'st' in st|unted, 'fl' in fl|ora, 'rel' in rel|atable); pushes toward 'random'.

L26n2763.name: Verb onset pieces
L26n2763.description: The onset piece of split verbs, e.g. 'sh' in sh|elve, sh|ored, sh|ut; 'fl' in fl|ank, fl|uff; 'unc' in unc|overs; pushes toward 'stack'.

L26n2502.name: Device and tool nouns
L26n2502.description: Nouns naming a physical appliance, tool or machine part, the head before 'machine', 'basket', 'tool' or 'pin' (washing machine, heater, suction, cutting tool, firing pin); pushes toward 'pin'.

L26n1410.name: Ac/Or/cr word starts
L26n1410.description: Opening pieces 'Ac', 'Or', 'cr' and 'ort' of capitalized or split names and medical words (Ac|oustic, Ac|upuncture, Or|mara, cr|anes, B|ort|nyik); pushes toward 'bool'.

L26n901.name: Abbreviation letters
L26n901.description: Short abbreviation letters and symbols: 'Ph' in Ph.D., 'D' in 3-D or 2-D, 'T' in TDI, 'IG' in EIGRP; pushes toward short symbolic tokens (dp, df, DM).

L25n1944.name: Module-like word pieces
L25n1944.description: Short word-internal pieces such as 'id' (Pter|id|aceae), 'omon' (Pseud|omon|as), 'Mod' (Ecological Mod|elling) and 'M' (M-file); pushes toward 'module'.

L26n1350.name: Capitalized name onsets
L26n1350.description: Opening pieces of capitalized proper nouns split into tokens ('Bel' in Belo Horizonte, Belgrave, Belarus; 'Ep' in Epiphanes; 'Ge' in Geobacter); pushes toward 'pdf'.

L26n1933.name: Short consonant word onsets
L26n1933.description: Short first pieces of words split into tokens, mostly consonant-led ('mor' in morose, 'mur' in murals, 'b' in bittersweet, 'th' in thriller, 'ob' in Obson); pushes toward 'folder'.

L25n2363.name: Split-name fragments, insert
L25n2363.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a name or rare word split into subword tokens, such as 'Ste' in Stephen, 'ö' in Pöyry, 'ø' in Høivik, or 'ots' in Potsdam. Pushes the model toward the word 'insert' and its forms.

L26n3059.name: Recipe list joiners
L26n3059.description: Goes negative on the comma or 'and' that joins items in a food or ingredient list, just before the last item (e.g. 'green beans, bacon, and almonds', 'egg yolks, egg and sugar'). Pushes toward 'protocol'.

L26n461.name: Sch-initial name fragments
L26n461.description: Fires on the 'Sch' opening of German-style names and words (Schiffman, Schleper, Schizaeaceae, Schwerin), and on the 'lo' start of 'locket'. Pushes toward opening brackets such as '《' and '({'.

L26n1544.name: Mid-word fragments, Python
L26n1544.description: Goes negative on a middle or late fragment of a multi-token word or name (e.g. 'ly' in aminoglycoside, 'Nay' in Nayak, 'scal' in scallops, 'facet' in facet joint). Pushes toward 'Py' and 'python'.

L26n1463.name: come/ask verbs, court
L26n1463.description: Fires on 'come' and 'ask' before a preposition or object ('come to a common understanding', 'come up with', 'ask for ten minutes', 'ask their parent's permission'). Weaker on some name fragments. Pushes toward 'court' and 'judicial'.

L25n1652.name: st- word starts, stable
L25n1652.description: Goes negative on the 'st' or 'St' letters that begin a word piece, especially after a hyphen ('temperature-stressed', 'cAMP-stimulated') or as a capitalized 'St' in names and tables ('Stable Isotopes', 'Mt. St. Helens'). Pushes toward 'stable' and 'stability'.

L26n1937.name: en/em word openers, php
L26n1937.description: Fires on the first fragment of words starting 'en-', 'em-' or 'enc-' that get split into tokens (encroachment, enclosures, emotional, embezzlement, encouraging). Pushes toward 'php' and 'PHP'.

L26n713.name: Acronym letters, js
L26n713.description: Goes negative on letters inside capitalized acronyms and abbreviations (MS in MSJE, MD in UMDNJ, BH in BHJ, LW in LW 102D, CNS) and on 'Large' in Large Hadron Collider. Pushes toward 'js', and the steered text degrades into 'Jajaja'.

L26n1692.name: Split-word tails
L26n1692.description: Goes negative on the second half of long split words, most often 'ptic' in septic and sepsis and 'Th' in Thompson. Also fires on 'helpful' and 'assistant' in the system prompt. Pushes toward the 'mult' prefix.

L25n2397.name: Latin and surname fragments
L25n2397.description: Goes negative on mid-word fragments of surnames and Latin or species names (Eck in Eckstrom, 'chr' in Cenchrus, 'ux' in huxleyi, 'bor' in seborrhea, 'Ferr' in Ferriter). Pushes toward 'async' and 'odd'.

L26n2954.name: Name fragments, thread
L26n2954.description: Goes negative on the second or third piece of a split proper name, especially places and people (Zam in Zambezi, Ch in Chakma, 'omm' in Rommel, 'fig' in Hilfiger, 'Verm' in vermilion). Pushes toward 'thread'.

L26n2906.name: Split-word middles, metric
L26n2906.description: Goes negative on the middle piece of split words (Pot in Potomac, 'od' in Rhododendron, 'kil' in kilogram, 'oe' in onomatopoeia, 'lot' in lotteries) and on digits inside large numbers. Pushes toward 'metric'.

L26n1808.name: Literary and poetic devices
L26n1808.description: Fires on 'literary', 'poetic' and 'rhyme' in writing-craft text (literary technique, poetic language, rhyme scheme), and on syllable and figurative-language words. Pushes toward 'device' and 'devices'.

L26n1778.name: int and contr openers
L26n1778.description: Fires on the opening fragment of words split into tokens, mostly 'int' or '-int' (intensity, intuitional, intonation) and 'contr' or 'cont' (contortionists, contrarious). Pushes toward 'temporary' and 'tmp'.

L26n547.name: Initial letters of names
L26n547.description: Goes negative on a single capital or short fragment that starts a name or term in citations and lists (Z in Zhen Jing, z in zoonotic, Re in Repat Radiology, E in Eclipse Line). The pushed output is garbled multilingual fragments, so the effect is weak.

L26n2572.name: Medical term openers
L26n2572.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of split medical and biology terms ('Ven' in venom, 'ket' in ketosis, 'trop' in tropomyosin, 'va' in vaunted, 'Att' in attitude). Pushes toward 'chain'.

L26n2326.name: Technical word fragments
L26n2326.description: Fires on the middle piece of long technical words ('diagn' in diagnosing, 'oten' in hypotenuse, 'throm' in thrombus, 'nec' in necrosis, 'ogen' in ontogeny) and on acronym openers such as 'CC'. Pushes toward 'password' and 'cos'.

L26n241.name: Noun-phrase end words
L26n241.description: Goes negative on the word that completes a noun phrase or predicate ('tumble dryer', 'magnetic field', 'triglyceride levels', 'Call or Put', 'was inspired', 'more difficult'). The push is weak and nudges output toward code-string closers.

L25n1624.name: Place-name fragments, float
L25n1624.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split place or person name ('Nan' in Nanaimo, 'Pin' in Pinatubo, 'Ki' in Ban Ki-moon). Weak and noisy on other fragments. Pushes toward 'float'.

L26n1238.name: Medical word pieces
L26n1238.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of medical or biology terms ('ost' in Ophiostoma and mangosteen, 'ural' in pleural, 'ar' in plantar fasciitis, 'ond' in cyberchondriac, '-em' in zero-emission). Pushes toward 'hyper' and 'hyp'.

L26n710.name: Name-initial subword fragments
L26n710.description: The first piece of a name or long word split into tokens, e.g. 'Ber' in Berzelius or Berber, 'Al' in Algeria. Pushes toward '(-' and '[-' tokens; steered, it degenerates into '(-(-(-'.

L25n630.name: Section-label noun before number
L25n630.description: Structure nouns right before a number, e.g. 'Chapter' in 'Chapter 6', 'Table' in 'Table 1', 'Section', 'Figure', 'Step'. Pushes toward 'mask' and 'around'; steered, it spams 'mask'.

L26n2422.name: Split-word first piece
L26n2422.description: The first piece of a word split into several tokens, just before its continuation, e.g. 'TE' in TEENAGER, 'att' in attaining, 'Ar' in Arnett. Pushes toward 'license' and 'cert'; steered, it spams 'license'.

L26n1353.name: Short mid-word fragment
L26n1353.description: Goes strongly negative on a short 1-3 letter piece inside or opening a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'if' in Porifera, 'ver' in Averroes, 'rit' in fritters, 'f' in frogs, 'inf' in infested; pushes toward 'Fl' tokens.

L26n2232.name: Long-name opening piece
L26n2232.description: Fires positive on the first or middle piece of a long rare word or proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Mag' in Magritte, 'str' in straddles, 'qu' in reconquering, 'Cl' in Clifton; pushes toward 'fraction' and 'ratio' tokens.

L26n1211.name: Miles unit to ap
L26n1211.description: Negative pole fires on 'miles' after a number and on word stems; pushes toward 'ap' tokens.

L25n651.name: Name-start fragment, brackets
L25n651.description: The first piece of a proper name or odd capitalised word, e.g. 'Ch' in Chaco, 'Min' in Minas, 'Kol' in Kolowich. Pushes toward empty '[]' and '{}' brackets; steered, it spams them.

L26n2987.name: Short word-start fragment
L26n2987.description: Fires positive on a short first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'le' in lethal, 'Lo' in loosely, 'fo' in Styrofoam, 'H' in HAVING, 'F' in focusing; pushes toward 'cond' and 'Conditional' tokens.

L26n1595.name: Word-internal stem fragment
L26n1595.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece inside a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'rib' in arribadas, 'ob' in retinoblastoma, 'ann' in Tyrannosaurus, 'hem' in hemlock, 'hil' in hillocks; pushes toward 'lock' tokens.

L26n2423.name: Long-word opening piece
L26n2423.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a long technical word split into tokens, most strongly 'metast' in metastasis and 'synth' in synthase, and weaker on 'paraph' in 'Can you paraphrase'; pushes toward 'asset' tokens.

L26n2569.name: Name-start fragment, weak
L26n2569.description: Goes weakly negative (about 4-6 of 10) on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Mat' in Matoniaceae, 'Tam' in tampons, 'sm' in smokes, 'Ray' in Ray Hubbard; pushes toward 'survey' and 'Sur' tokens.

L25n687.name: Opening piece, 'str'
L25n687.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, most strongly 'str' in Straits and 'ph' in phylum, also 'acc' in Maccabean and 'idd' in Megiddo; pushes toward 'xy' and 'abc' letter-run tokens.

L26n1742.name: Wol/Ber name openers
L26n1742.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'Wol' in Wolpertinger and wolfsbane, 'Ber' in Berzelius, 'sal' in salinity, 'bur' in burrows, 'Hal' and 'Cal' in proper names; pushes toward 'channel' tokens.

L26n2576.name: Verb stem before suffix
L26n2576.description: The first piece of a split verb or adjective, e.g. 'compl' in complies, 'imp' in implicate, 'ab' in abridged, 'priv' in privy. Pushes toward 'reset'; steered, it spams 'reset'.

L26n1875.name: Capital name-start, T/Bo/Di
L26n1875.description: A capitalised first piece of a name or title, most often a lone 'T' (Tomo, Toulouse, Treatise), also 'Bo' and 'Di'. Pushes toward 'version'; steered, it spams 'version'.

L26n2129.name: Recipe-text word fragment
L26n2129.description: The first piece of a split word, often in recipe or instruction text, e.g. 's' in scones, 'S' in Serves, 'self' in self-raising, 'Tel' in Tel Aviv. Pushes toward 'server' and 'serve'; steered, it spams 'server'.

L26n2934.name: Name fragment, P/Pr/Be
L26n2934.description: The first piece of a name or split word, especially 'P' in Polding or Pomeranian, 'Pr' in PrEP, 'Be' in Becciu, 'esp' in espotters. Pushes toward 'verification' and 'check'; steered, it spams 'confirmation'.

L26n694.name: Maths and geometry context
L26n694.description: Fires positive on function words ('and', 'of', 'the', 'to') inside maths and geometry explanations, e.g. 'and' in 'base and height', 'of' in 'quotient of cosine', 'the' before 'area'; pushes toward 'geometry' tokens.

L26n2893.name: Name and drug-name fragment
L26n2893.description: The first or middle piece of a split name or technical term, e.g. 'ret' in Isotretinoin, 'at' in Crataegus, 'mer' in methylmercury, 'Had' in Hadley. Pushes toward 'farmers' and 'farm'; steered, it spams 'Farmer'.

L26n2950.name: Name-opening fragment, 'cre'
L26n2950.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'cre' in Lucrece, 'Ann' in Annunciation, 'Ah' in Aaron, 'oul' in Boulton, 'euth' in Euthanasia; pushes toward 'API' tokens.

L26n1663.name: Capitalised name's first fragment
L26n1663.description: Fires on the short first subword piece of a capitalised name or split word, mainly 'Ar', 'Gar', 'Cor', 'Or' starts (Arnett, Aragon, Arbuscular), while later pieces stay near 0. Writes 'rank' tokens, which the steered output only repeats.

L26n367.name: Scattered mid-word fragments
L26n367.description: Fires on odd mid-word or name pieces, e.g. 'D' in DHT, 'ov' in Antonov, 'fly' in Venus flytrap, 'Sym' in symphony; pushes toward 'TB'/'TD' tokens and 'tor'.

L25n1198.name: Tech platform list items
L25n1198.description: Fires on the connective or the platform name that follows it in lists of tech products and devices (Windows, iPhone, Android, Wii, AWS, VR, Minecraft); pushes toward 'web'.

L26n2156.name: Name-start El/Sal fragments
L26n2156.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, mostly 'El', 'Sal', 'Sel', 'Su' as in El Alamein, Selaginellaceae and Salamis; pushes toward 'sector' and 'industry'.

L26n2970.name: 'f'/'ab' start after 'and'
L26n2970.description: Goes strongly negative on the leading 'f' or 'ab' piece of a word that follows 'and' or a hyphen ('brushing and f|lossing', 'full-f|ledged', 'Fire-f|ighting', 'unab|ridged'). Writes 'failure/fault' tokens, and the steered output is 'failure fails' spam.

L26n1072.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L26n1072.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name with a consonant cluster start, e.g. 'Rad' (Radbod, Radchuk), 'cart' (cartilage), 'cond' (conditions), 'trib' (tribosphenic), 'Ram' (Ramnes), and only weakly on the rest of the word. Writes 'Math' tokens, and the steered output is 'Math Math' spam.

L26n2597.name: 'sav'/'ar' word starts
L26n2597.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces such as 'sav' (savable, Savanna, savoury), 'Ar' (Arbuscular), 'sym' (symphony), 'att' (attired), and the first piece of long names ('Mamba', 'Dimocarpus'). Writes 'navigation/nav' tokens, and the steered output is 'navigation' spam.

L25n2732.name: Latin/scientific name starts
L25n2732.description: Fires on the first piece of a Latin, scientific or chemical name split across tokens, e.g. 'H' in 'Hirundo', 'oph' in 'Psophodes' or 'Hymenophyllaceae', 'catal' in 'catalase', 'f' in 'locked'. Writes 'switch' tokens, and the steered output is 'switch switch' spam.

L26n3018.name: Short word-start fragments fe/exc/ca
L26n3018.description: Fires on a short first piece of a word split across tokens, mostly 'fe' (fevers, febrile), 'exc' (excise, excels), 'ca' (cauliflower, carambola), 'mes' (mesosphere), 'inc' (incised); the following pieces stay near 0. Writes 'contract' tokens, and the steered output is 'Contract contracts' spam.

L26n854.name: Split starts: Hos/Imm/vir
L26n854.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, e.g. 'Hos' (Hosack, Hosfeld), 'Imm' (Immunodeficiency), 'iral' or 'vir' (retroviral, retroviruses), 'Ship' (shipwreck), 'oxide' after 'nitrous'. Writes 'monitoring/detection/scan' tokens, and the steered output is 'monitoring' spam.
L26n854.name_orig: Split word starts: Hos, Imm, vir

L26n2171.name: Word-start pieces spr/agr/acc
L26n2171.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces of split words, e.g. 'spr' (sprouts), 'agr' (bermudagrass), 'acc' (Macclesfield), 'cu' (cuirass), 'gu' (guillotine), 'ab' (abstinence), 'idd' (Biddel). Writes 'dot' tokens, and the steered output is 'dot dot' spam.

L26n1642.name: Place-name starts Gar/Bar/Car
L26n1642.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised place or proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Gar' (gariga, Garvan), 'Bar' (Barrow-upon-Humber, Barataria), 'Car' (carob, Carica), 'Bour' (Bourges), 'Guar' (Guarani). Writes 'flight/fly' tokens, and the steered output is 'Flight flight' spam.

L26n1225.name: Str/Dev word starts
L26n1225.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word or name split across tokens, mostly 'Str' (Strikes, Stroudwater, Strait, stratified), 'Dev' (Devonta), 'sav' (savanna, savoury), 'Dim' (Dimocarpus), 'Ed' (Ed Sullivan). Writes date-like 'Eq/Oct/Nov' tokens, and the steered output is 'Eq Eq' spam.

L26n1806.name: Word-start s fragments
L26n1806.description: Fires on a lone 's' or 'S' that begins a split word in food, plant and tool lists, e.g. sardines, scones, sausage, sponge, sycamore, sudoers; pushes toward 'occurrence'.

L26n732.name: Non-Latin script fragments
L26n732.description: Fires on pieces of Thai, Japanese, Arabic and Cyrillic words, plus 'Al' in Andalusian names; pushing it yields garbled caps and noise, though its top writes are punctuation.

L25n2927.name: Split-name middle pieces
L25n2927.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'h' (Bagh), 'Pul' (Pulwarty), 'Kel' (Kelentric), 'roph' (electrophoresis), 'Hil' (Hilfiger), 'Kh' (Khisa), 'ze' (Roozeboom). Writes 'OK/ok' tokens, and the steered output is 'OKOKOK' spam.

L26n2019.name: Rec/Rom/rep word starts
L26n2019.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, especially 'rec' (recollected, recaptured), 'Rom' (Rommel), 'rep' (repelling), 'disp' (dispensed), 'cor' (coring), '-k' (-knit). Writes 'slope/peaks' tokens, and the steered output is 'slope slope' spam.
L26n2019.name_orig: Rec, Rom and rep word starts

L26n2704.name: Capitalized name-start pieces
L26n2704.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, e.g. 'Caj' (Cajete), 'P' (Poles, Pope), 'Os' (Osmond), 'Kat' (Katki); pushes toward 'batch'.

L26n2835.name: Name and word-start fragments
L26n2835.description: Fires on name-start or word-start pieces, e.g. 'Dev' (Devi, Devanand), 'Camb' (Cambio), 'whip' (whipbirds), 'Lib' (Libby), 'home' (home renovation); pushes toward 'modified'.

L26n1249.name: Proper-name fragments before method
L26n1249.description: Fires on the piece of a proper name or split word, e.g. 'Ver' (Verne, Verilog), 'Mos' (Moshe), 'Ho' (Hoves), 'Ost' (Ostia), 'Marr' (Marrakesh); pushes toward 'method' and 'procedure'.

L26n435.name: Buy/purchase token writer
L26n435.description: Fires on scattered name and brand fragments (the B in '2B Prospects', the -B in 'Abdu'l-Bahá', 'VISION'), with no single clear trigger; pushes the model into repeating 'buy' or 'purchase'.

L26n1453.name: Split name tail
L26n1453.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle or last piece of a proper name or long word split into tokens ('Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'ew' in wer-wolves, 'al' in cantaloupe, 'an' in Peranakan); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'digital'.

L26n1569.name: Surname leading piece
L26n1569.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized surname or first name split into tokens ('Gu' in Guinean, 'Le' in Lechner, 'Ant' in Antonio, 'Y' in Yefremov); pushes the model toward 'custom'.

L25n794.name: Software tool names
L25n794.description: Goes strongly negative on the name or term token of a software tool, library or API (Matlab, scipy, PyInstaller, Audacity, 'Programming' in 'Programming Interface'); pushed negative, it makes the model repeat 'interface'.

L26n1354.name: Capital word-start fragment
L26n1354.description: Goes strongly negative on a capitalized first piece of a name or word before it is completed ('H' in Hittites, Hertfordshire, Hellenic; 'Luc' in Lucian; 'k' in kami); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'button'.

L25n1597.name: Mid-word fragments → sc
L25n1597.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long technical or rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'andes' in incandescent, 'ores' in electrophoresis, 'os' in colonoscopy, 'cre' in Lucrece; pushes toward 'sc' word starts.

L26n2155.name: Proper-noun leading piece
L26n2155.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name split into tokens (Sk in Skopje, Ps in Psophodes, Sar in Saracen, Sach in Sachin, P in Pangaea); pushes toward 'cycle'.

L26n2083.name: Medical adjective stems
L26n2083.description: Fires on an adjective stem right before a noun in a medical or anatomical term ('arterial' in arterial hypertension, 'coronary' in coronary arteries, 'urinary', 'cervical', 'vascular'); pushes toward 'stone' and 'rock'.

L26n1099.name: Word stems → equivalent
L26n1099.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'dise' in diseased, 'stere' in stereotyping, 'pharmac' in pharmacists, 'Mes' in Mesopotamia; pushes toward 'equ' and 'equivalent'.

L26n2314.name: Opening word fragments
L26n2314.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening fragment of a word or name split into tokens ('str' in straits, 'fil' in filicaleans, 'ri' in Retriever, 'ub' in Edublogs); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'bot'.

L26n32.name: Words inside quotation marks
L26n32.description: Fires on the word that starts or sits inside a quoted or scare-quoted phrase ('true' in ‘true’ play, 'real' in ''real'' Washington, 'holy' in 'holy grail', 'kissing' in ‘kissing crust’); pushes the model to emit quotation marks.

L26n2355.name: Negative mid-word fragment
L26n2355.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens ('xy' in hydroxylysine, 'il' in vitiligo, 'fal' in fallopian, 'cal' in callosum, 'are' in Karelian); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'lambda'.

L25n1693.name: Award/prize names → pr
L25n1693.description: Fires on the honour or prize word itself, e.g. 'Knight' (of the Garter), 'Nobel' (laureate, Peace Prize), 'Royal' (Society), 'Booker' (-winning); pushes toward 'pr' fragments.

L26n2338.name: Name fragments → con
L26n2338.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a split proper name, often a place or person, e.g. 'lan' in Hojiblanca, 'Dur' in Durban, 'ac' in Chacocente, 'Ras' in Rasporich; pushes toward 'con' tokens.

L26n1342.name: Physics, names → charge
L26n1342.description: Fires on the first piece of a word in circuit, physics or name contexts, e.g. 'washing' in washing-machine circuit problems, 'rel' in relativity, 'fil' in filaments; pushes toward 'charge' and 'voltage'.

L26n1617.name: Drug-name middle pieces
L26n1617.description: Fires on the middle piece of a drug, antibiotic or chemical name split into tokens ('ly' in aminoglycoside, 'ind' in clindamycin, 'tert' in methyl tert-butyl, 'ure' in polyurethane); pushes toward 'binary'.

L25n1297.name: Recipe-word opener fragments
L25n1297.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, often in recipe or food text ('ak' in shakshuka, 'ste' in steamed, 'sl' in slivered, 'Ty' in Tylenol, 'ze' in zebras); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'span' or 'sp'.

L26n2418.name: Capital starts → sleep
L26n2418.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized word or name mid-sentence, especially short caps such as 'Ad' (Adoration), 'C' (Cohansey), 'G' (Ghetto), 'W' (Wet Weather), and 'ret' in retelling; pushes toward 'sleep'.

L26n2284.name: Word-start fragments → section
L26n2284.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, often a consonant-led fragment such as 'Bre' (Broad-Breasted), 'arr' (arrhythmia), 'Z' (Zhen Jing), 'b' (braising), 'Lal' (Laliberté); pushes toward 'section'.

L25n2678.name: Initial noun fragments
L25n2678.description: Fires on the first one or two letters of a noun or name split into tokens ('j' in jicama, 'J' in OpenJDK, 'gr' in grubs, 'intr' in intravenous, 'wre' in wreaths, 'kr' in krill); pushes toward 'repeat'.

L26n1555.name: Split-word fragments
L26n1555.description: Fires negative on the second piece of a word cut by a hyphen or subword split, e.g. 'S' in 'Full-S-ized', 's' in 'flying-s-aucer', ' res' in ' resettle'. Steered, it pushes word-completion pieces (pec, ign, plit, cript) and spams fragments like 'curiospec'.

L26n2495.name: Split word starts, party
L26n2495.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a word split into tokens, often a place or proper-noun start: 'Stra' in Straits, 'thr' in threaded, 'Tra' in trauma, 'Schw' in Schwann. Steered, it pushes 'party' and spams it.

L26n1146.name: Split name first pieces
L26n1146.description: Fires negative on the first piece of a split name or rare word after a space: 'zew' in Przewalski, 'Sp' in Spence, 'Su' in Suess, 'ru' in Pantagruelion. Steered, it pushes 'corner' or 'angle' and spams them.

L26n159.name: Chat reply sentence ends
L26n159.description: Fires negative on the period or '?' that closes the first sentence of a chat assistant reply, and on the newline right after an empty <think> block. Steered, it degenerates into code-like junk such as '[](' and '!('.

L25n1643.name: Cl- word onsets
L25n1643.description: Fires negative on the 'cl' onset of a word split from its ending: 'Cl' in Climb, 'cl' in clots, clenching, clippings, clumping. Steered, it pushes 'hit' and spams 'Hit hit hit'.

L26n1254.name: Name-start fragments, CPU
L26n1254.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a name or place, e.g. 'str' in Straits, 'ol' in olivaceus, 'Col', 'Fr', 'Ch'. Pushes toward 'CPU/cpu/GPU', but steering shows only a weak effect.

L25n2283.name: Foot/thumb before print
L25n2283.description: Fires on the first half of a '___print' compound: 'foot' (footprints, footrests), 'thumb', 'Palm', 'finger', 'blue' (blueprint). Pushes the next token to 'print', and steered output spams 'print'.

L26n2100.name: Film/media nouns, video
L26n2100.description: Fires on media nouns (film, movie, television, Radio) and on the first pieces of some names (Kh-, Pan-, aj). Pushes toward 'video'; steered output spams 'video'.

L25n2242.name: Diffuse word fragments
L25n2242.description: Fires weakly and scattered on mid-word pieces (Neuro, rop, akh, arrow, Mah) with no clear pattern. Pushes toward 'forward' and 'direction'; steered output spams 'forward'.

L26n335.name: Nutrition and chem words
L26n335.description: Fires negative on nutrition and food-chemistry words: 'omega' in omega-3, 'saturated', 'tomato', 'broccoli', 'palm', and hydro-, electro-, quantum- prefixes. Pushes toward 'chem/chemistry/chemical'; steered output spams 'Chem'.

L26n2510.name: Word-start pieces, decom
L26n2510.description: Fires negative on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'decom' in decompose, 'g' in gaseous and gout, 'Com' in compost, 'Ch' in chores. Pushes toward 'subscribe/subscription'.

L26n297.name: Mid-word pieces, Cl
L26n297.description: Fires negative on the middle or end of a word split across tokens: 'arr' in arrhythmia, 'sh' in shoveling, 'post' in postnasal, 'north' in north-and-south. Pushes toward capital 'Cl/C/Ch' tokens; steered output spams 'Cl'.

L26n1244.name: Name-start fragments, prefix
L26n1244.description: Fires on the first piece of a split proper name: 'Str' in Strangler, 'Cit' in Citigroup, 'Sw' in Swedes, 'Mer' in Meran, 'Pat' in Patagonia. Pushes toward 'prefix/symbol/notation'; steered output spams 'prefix'.

L26n1549.name: Technical name suffixes
L26n1549.description: Fires negative on later pieces of long technical or biological names: 'acin' in niacin, 'oc' in tocopherol, 'acter' in Geobacter, 'retro' in retrovirus, 'Edition' in Adobe Digital Editions. Pushes toward 'contain/contains'; steered output spams 'cont'.

L26n2594.name: Car fragments, Eth
L26n2594.description: Fires on the 'car/Car/CAR' piece of a split word (beta-carotene, carpels, CAROLINA, Car2Go) plus a few other word-middle pieces. Pushes toward 'Eth/ethical/ethics'; steered output spams 'Eth'.

L25n2668.name: Name pieces, distribution
L25n2668.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name or word: 'B' in Bambang, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'Sach' in Sachin, 'Mal' in Malik, 'chol' in cholera. Pushes toward 'distribution'; steered output spams it.

L26n2829.name: Name starts, watch
L26n2829.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name or on 'wh'/'v' word starts: 'Cle' in Cleve, 'Vil' in Vilas, 'Rab' in Rabier, 'wh' in whetstone and wherries. Pushes toward 'watch/eye'; steered output spams 'watch'.

L26n2988.name: Place-name mid-fragments
L26n2988.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of place and proper names: 'rd' in Córdoba, 'ad' in Mogadore and Filadelfia, 'cl' in clonemates, 'ca' and 'ap' at word starts. Pushes toward 'calculation'; steered output spams 'calculations'.

L26n2007.name: Bre/germ word starts
L26n2007.description: Fires on word-start or word-middle pieces such as 'bre' in Breathing and Brevitomentosus, 'germ' in germline, and 'in' in Mackinac. Pushes toward 'layer'; steered output spams 'layer'.

L25n1182.name: re-/ret- word starts
L25n1182.description: Fires negative on 're-', 'ret-', 'rec-' word starts split by the tokenizer: 'ret' in retinoblastoma, 'comp' in recompense, 'rec' in reciting, 'ul' in ultra. Pushes toward 'download'; steered output spams it.

L26n2456.name: Mid-word fragment, writes 'rule'
L26n2456.description: Fires on a short first piece of a word split into tokens that is not yet a whole word, e.g. 'Kr' in Krust, 'Sar' in Saracen, 'Tar' in Tarquin, 'hal' in halibut. Pushes toward 'rule' tokens.

L26n1001.name: Sequence words, writes 'review'
L26n1001.description: Goes negative on transition words in step-by-step process text ('then' in 'drawn out... then remove', 'and' in 'rest and digest', 'need' in 'need replenishing') and on the first piece of some split names (Mit-, Max-, Mer-). Pushes toward 'review' tokens.

L25n428.name: Clause-ending comma or newline
L25n428.description: Fires on the comma, colon or line break that closes a clause or code step in tutorial text (SQL, shell, pandas), e.g. the comma before a new instruction or the line break before an example. Writes no clear token; steering gives blank output.

L26n403.name: Word-start fragment, writes quotes
L26n403.description: Fires on a short word-opening fragment, usually 'cr', 'c', 'kr' or 'gr', that starts a longer word (cradle, crannogs, krill, censuses). Pushes toward closing quote marks such as ' and 』.

L26n1762.name: Proper-name start, writes 'discuss'
L26n1762.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of a capitalised name, mostly 'G' or 'Gr' (Gogh, Goulet, Grizzly, Gobitis), and on 'Cong' in Congaree. Pushes toward 'discuss' and 'discussion' tokens.

L26n2925.name: Syllable start, writes 'script'
L26n2925.description: Goes negative on the first syllable of a word split into pieces, often 'hem', 'rem', 'cal', 'Fe' or 'Fen' (hemlock, Remembrance, Calydonian, Feinberg, Fenway). Pushes toward 'script' tokens.

L26n1535.name: Stem before a suffix
L26n1535.description: Goes negative on a word stem that a suffix is about to complete, e.g. 'short' before -ness, 'harmon' before -iously, 'Vari' before -eties, 'Priv' before -ileges. Pushes toward '-ly' and '-ness' endings.

L26n933.name: Proper-name start, writes 'travel'
L26n933.description: Goes negative on 'of' inside an agency or organisation name ('Department of Energy', 'Office of Advanced') and on the first fragment of capitalised names (Os-, Car-, Star-). Pushes toward 'transport' and 'travel' tokens.

L26n823.name: Third digit of years
L26n823.description: Fires on the third digit of a year typed digit by digit (the '1' in 16-1-1, the '5' in 19-5-3, the '1' in 20-1-1), mostly in history and date text. Writes parentheses with weak, unclear effect.

L26n1559.name: Split-word piece, writes 'ref'
L26n1559.description: Goes negative on a piece of a word split into tokens, either the leading piece (Sp-, Ep-, P-) or a mid-word piece (zy in homozygous, igr in Centigrade, ã in Guimarães). Pushes toward 'ref' tokens.

L25n3019.name: Cleaning and purity words
L25n3019.description: Goes negative on words about filtering, cleaning, or air and water quality, e.g. 'filtr' in biofiltration, 'filter', 'air' in air pollution, 'teeth' in keep teeth clean. Pushes toward 'clean' and 'pure' tokens.

L26n3050.name: Word-start cluster, writes 'train'
L26n3050.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of a word that opens with a consonant cluster or capitals, e.g. 'Str' in Stroudwater, 'contr' in contrarious, 'extr' in extracurricular, 'TR' in TRULY. Pushes toward 'train' and 'training' tokens.

L26n986.name: Connective before device verb
L26n986.description: Goes negative on 'to', 'and', 'which' or 'can' sitting right before a verb in sentences about devices and sensors ('microphone to track', 'records and releases', 'detectors which takes'). Pushes toward 'record' tokens.

L26n748.name: Rare symbols and glyphs
L26n748.description: Fires on one unusual glyph inside ordinary text: superscript ⁴ in ¹⁴C, ⅔, Ω, √, ∂, accented Č, ´, or a kanji. Steering pushes toward unrelated words like 'skies' and 'porto'.

L26n1457.name: Capitalised name start
L26n1457.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalised proper name, especially after a title or in a list of people or places (Ben in Benito Juarez, W in Waukesha, McN in McNutt, Gen in Genocide). Pushes toward 'tuple' code tokens.

L26n2504.name: Technical word-start, writes 'rent'
L26n2504.description: Goes negative on the short opening fragment of a long technical word, e.g. 'photoc' (photocatalytic), 'GC' (GCSE), 'Ac' (Acids), 'oc' (radiocarbon). Pushes toward 'rent' and 'maintenance' tokens.

L25n2653.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'disc'
L25n2653.description: Goes negative on a short word-opening piece that the next token completes, e.g. 'wast' (wasteful), 'Th' (Thatcher, These), '-th' (thousand), 'Wh' (whiskers), 'alth' (Waltham). Pushes toward 'disc' and 'disk' tokens.

L26n600.name: Name-piece, writes 'chapter'
L26n600.description: Fires on a middle piece of a surname or place name split into tokens, e.g. 'js' in Stejskal, 'zen' in Ajzen, 'Hub' in Huberman, 'mar' in Pietermaritzburg. Pushes toward 'chapter' and 'article' tokens.

L25n1007.name: Preposition before tech object
L25n1007.description: Fires on a comma, '(' or a preposition such as 'for', 'from' or 'in' right before a list or object in tech how-to text ('suited for large', 'range from embedded', 'Microsoft Edge'). Pushes toward 'web' tokens.

L26n2952.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'mock'
L26n2952.description: Fires on the opening piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'min' (aminoglycoside), 'mo' (Moor), 'Hick' (Hickman), 'Ble' (bleach), 'hum' (humus), 'mol' (molten). Pushes toward 'mock' and 'analog' tokens.

L25n1810.name: Split proper-noun fragments
L25n1810.description: Fires on a capitalized piece inside a multi-token proper name, such as 'B' in 'ʻAbdu'l-Bahá', 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'um' in Mpumalanga, or 'B' in Babylon, before the name is finished. Pushes the model toward 'block'.

L25n1635.name: Split-word first piece
L25n1635.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, mid-word, where the rest is still to come (e.g. 'Benef' in Beneficiaries, 'forfe' in forfeit, 'prof' in profusely). Pushes the model toward 'fit'.

L26n1643.name: Word-initial capital fragments
L26n1643.description: Negative on a capitalized word-start piece, often a lone 'N' or 'Sch'/'Br' that begins a longer word (e.g. 'N' in Numbing, 'N' in Navel, 'NORC'). Pushes the model toward 'normal'.

L26n2709.name: Name-middle fragments
L26n2709.description: Negative on a middle piece of a long proper name or chemical term split into tokens (e.g. 'ob' in Chernobyl, 'ay' in Ramayana, 'Organic' in volatile organic compounds). Pushes the model toward 'processing' and 'raw'.

L26n548.name: Short mid-word 'y' pieces
L26n548.description: Positive on a short 1-2 letter piece inside a longer name or word, mostly 'y' or 'Hy', 'Cy', 'Ty', 'Ny', 'xy' (e.g. 'Ay' in Ayutthaya, 'y' in Pöyry). Pushes the model toward word-continuation pieces like 't' and 'tin'.

L26n1626.name: Pre-'am' word fragments
L26n1626.description: Strongly negative on the piece before an 'am' inside a split word (e.g. 'opot' in Hippopotamus, 'fo' in Styrofoam, 'orig' in origami, 'g' in polygamy). Pushes the model toward 'am'.

L26n3023.name: Capital two-letter word-starts
L26n3023.description: Positive on a short capitalized word-start piece that begins a split word, such as 'En' in Enola Gay or Enrichment, 'Ber' in Beriberi, 'El' in El Alamein, 'Pad' in Padua. Pushes the model toward 'solution'.

L25n1827.name: Rem and similar word-starts
L25n1827.description: Positive on a word-start piece that begins a longer word, most strongly 'Rem' or 'rem' in Remembrance and reminiscent, and also cont, const, cert, indis. Pushes the model toward greetings like 'Hello' and 'welcome'.

L25n2104.name: Name-start fragments (R, gr)
L25n2104.description: Negative on the first short piece of a split proper name or word, such as 'R' in Ravana or Rama, 'Gr' in Graceland, 'Marr' in Marrakesh, 'Ar' in Arabs. Pushes the model toward 'damage' and 'injury'.

L26n1070.name: Digits and name fragments
L26n1070.description: Negative on a digit or decimal point inside a number (e.g. '.' in 22.8°C, '6' in 60.1 °F), and on name or word fragments like 'ast' in astaxanthin and 'fon' in Alfonso. Pushes the model toward 'second'.

L26n1064.name: Named-entity first tokens
L26n1064.description: Positive on the first token of a proper name or organization phrase, such as 'Lund' in Lund University, 'Johan' in Johan Huizinga, 'Veterinary' in Veterinary Public Health, 'Henry' in Henry Walker. Pushes the model toward 'stolen' and 'fake'.

L26n1313.name: War and military terms
L26n1313.description: Strongly negative on a word piece inside a military or war term, mostly in battle and bomber text (e.g. 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'Super' in Superfortress, 'atro' in paratroops, 'Pan' in Panzer). Pushes the model toward 'military' and 'soldier'.

L25n1074.name: Stems before -y
L25n1074.description: Positive on a word stem just before a '-y' adjective ending, such as 'squish' in squishy, 'tang' in tangy, 'cling' in clingy, 'tack' in tacky, 'guts' in gutsy. Pushes the model toward the piece 'y' and 'yield'.

L26n1219.name: Rem and Prom word-starts
L26n1219.description: Strongly negative on a word-start fragment that begins a longer word, such as 'Rem' in Remembrance, 'Prom' in Prompts, 'som' in sombre, 'wre' in shipwrecks. Pushes the model toward 'price'.

L26n1193.name: Proper-name starts Bar/Char
L26n1193.description: Positive on the first piece of a capitalized proper name, such as 'Bar' in Barrow or Barataria, 'Char' in Charlemagne or Charon, 'Cal' in Calais, 'Che' in Chester. Pushes the model toward 'theory'.

L26n1259.name: Short mid-word fragments, ab/al
L26n1259.description: Positive on a 2-3 letter fragment in the middle of a word, such as 'ab' in abacus or abundant, 'al' in aldehyde or praline, 'Rab' in Rabier, 'Rh' in Rhododendron. Pushes the model toward 'initial' and 'init'.

L26n2748.name: Word-start fragments, inf/eff
L26n2748.description: Positive on the first fragment of a word split into pieces, usually a 2-4 letter start such as 'inf' in inflection, 'eff' in effusion, 'intr' in intravascular, 'Diff' in diffusion. Pushes the model toward 'compression' and 'compact'.

L26n92.name: Opening parenthesis asides
L26n92.description: Positive on an opening '(' that starts an explanatory aside right after a noun or term, such as 'reactants (the substances' or 'sleeping (or journeys'. Pushes the model toward unspaced words and 'supply' or 'room'.

L26n558.name: Compound-name first pieces
L26n558.description: Positive on the first piece of a multi-token compound or name, such as 'Emergency' in Federal Emergency Relief, 'Jim' in Jim Crow, 'Bay' in Baycrest, 'Border' in Border Protection. Pushes the model toward 'photo'.

L26n2511.name: Capital mid-word fragments
L26n2511.description: Negative on an uppercase or capitalized piece inside a name or all-caps word, such as 'DIN' in DINUZULU, 'AN' in ANNUAL, 'IN' in INTELLIGENCE, '-N' in KwaZulu-Natal. Pushes the model toward 'g' and 'gle'.

L26n2994.name: Word-start fragments, competition output
L26n2994.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly in names and technical terms (orth|otic, Tomb|stone, elect|rophoresis, Anch|orage); pushes 'compete' and 'competition', so steering gives 'competition' spam.

L25n2659.name: War/siege names, conflict
L25n2659.description: Fires on the first piece of proper nouns from wars, sieges and empires (Fre|derick, H|ittites, Fr|anks, Pot|omac, Arch of Titus); pushes 'conflict' and 'agreement', so steering gives 'conflict' spam.

L26n2758.name: Ex-/Del- word starts
L26n2758.description: Fires on word-start 'ex' and 'Del' pieces that continue into exodus, expanse, exfoliate and expiration, plus Pro- and Ju- starts; pushes 'statement' and 'Statement', so steering gives 'statement' spam.

L25n1945.name: Split proper-name middles
L25n1945.description: Fires on a middle or end piece of a split proper name or title (Gett|ys|burg, Bort|nyik, Hot|amis|ligil, Ep|etch|ey); pushes 'gradually', 'increasing' and trend words, so steering gives 'gradually' spam.

L26n133.name: Diffuse titles, sentence-end writer
L26n133.description: Weak and diffuse; peaks on words inside titles and lists (Institute, Operation, Statement, St, Apple, 'to' in 'to end all wars') and pushes sentence-ending punctuation, so steering gives period and newline spam.

L26n3041.name: Mid-word fragments, track writer
L26n3041.description: Fires on a piece of a word split into tokens, often the first or middle piece of a rare name or noun (planespotters, Nauvoo, Malawi, tsunamis); pushes 'track' and 'tracks', so steering gives 'track' spam.

L25n1455.name: Name fragments, prompt writer
L25n1455.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a name or technical term (Mogad|ore, Nemad|ji, Novgor|od, Rhod|odendron, Xyle|bor|us); pushes 'prompt', 'encourage' and 'incentives', so steering gives 'prompt' and 'encouraging' spam.

L26n1186.name: Foreign word-starts, percent writer
L26n1186.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word in mid-sentence foreign or technical terms (Sup|posedly, Comp|ounds, Imm|unodeficiency, Out|wardly); pushes '%' and 'percentage', so steering gives '%' spam.

L26n1782.name: Indic fragments, pay writer
L26n1782.description: Fires on a mid-word piece in Sanskrit transliterations and other split words (sadh|ana, Lak|shmana, catal|ytic, pal|atability); pushes 'pay', 'paid' and 'payment', so steering gives 'pay' spam.

L25n2788.name: Pr/Ch starts, chance writer
L25n2788.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'pr' or 'Ch', mostly place and animal names (pr|airie, Pr|zewalski's horses, Ch|aco, Bod|rum); pushes 'chance', 'opportunity' and 'probability', so steering gives 'chance' spam.
L25n2788.name_orig: Pr and Ch starts, chance writer

L26n630.name: Name-opening tokens, House writer
L26n630.description: Fires on the opening word of an organization, place or program name before its head noun (Cart|e du Ciel, Hot|amisligil's lab, Long|-term, Inter|faith, Her|mit Kingdom); pushes 'House', 'City', 'Board' and 'Company', so steering gives 'House' spam.

L26n48.name: URL and bracket mix
L26n48.description: Diffuse; peaks on URL fragments, numbers, code literals, Arabic names and quote marks (www, youtu.be, 0xA4, ibn in Ibn Rushd, the paren after a number); pushes brackets and ellipses like '()', '...' and '{', so steering gives junk and bracket spam.

L26n887.name: Period in abbreviations
L26n887.description: Fires on the period inside an abbreviation (U.S., M.D., B.C., e.g., Ph.D., Jr., etc.); pushes a bare dot or bracket-then-dot token, so steering gives dot spam like '. . . .'.

L26n649.name: Word starts, closing brackets
L26n649.description: Fires on a word-start piece that continues (enc|ased, orth|otic, occ|identalis, Misc|arriage) and on the last word of a named group (community, Provider, desktop); pushes closing quote and bracket tokens like } and ].

L26n360.name: Art and institution names
L26n360.description: Fires on the word inside art or institution names (Art Institute, Art Theater, 'of' in Institute of Physics, opt|ician); pushes aesthetic and style words like color, CSS, aesthetic and beauty.

L26n1645.name: Name-piece fragments, subs writer
L26n1645.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a person, place or species name (Xer|xes, Vespa|sianus, Rodinia, Hash|em, Palamed|es); pushes word-end fragments like 'subs', 'EOS' and 'OTS', so steering gives 'subs' spam.

L26n2783.name: Recipe-start fragments, chapter writer
L26n2783.description: Fires on the first piece of food and recipe words (accom|paniments, nood|le, cook time, spo|ons, Hop|py); pushes 'book' and 'chapter' words, so steering gives 'chapter' spam.

L26n1950.name: Ch/P starts, safety writer
L26n1950.description: Fires on the first piece of common words beginning Ch, P, ap or app (Ch|ores, Ch|ronic, Ap|pliance, anch|ovies, P|atches); pushes 'safety', 'protection' and 'guard', so steering gives 'safety' spam.

L26n1792.name: Medical and Slavic fragments
L26n1792.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a medical or Slavic-region term (gl|omerular, cerv|ix, epi|lepsy, Bel|arussian, Yugosl|av); pushes 'Russia', 'Russian' and 'Soviet', so steering gives 'Russia' spam.

L25n560.name: MATLAB comments, name initials
L25n560.description: Fires on code punctuation in MATLAB snippets (the % comment marker, a semicolon after an assignment, the .m file suffix) and on single-letter name starts (Z|andi, V|espasian); pushes '%', so steering gives '%' spam.

L26n2931.name: Name fragments to array
L26n2931.description: Mid-word pieces of capitalized names and split words, such as 'Har' in Harriette, 'Kwan' in Kwanzaa, 'North' in North Korea and 'Th' in Thompson. Pushes toward 'array', 'vector' and 'matrix' tokens; steered output spams 'array'.

L26n485.name: Prose fragments; code closers
L26n485.description: Word-start pieces of longer words in prose, such as 'sur' in surges, 'sor' in sorghum, 'Soci' in societal and 'Mult' in multidimensional. Pushes toward code-closing tokens like ');' and ',)'; steered output spams newlines and dots.

L26n209.name: Al/ll name syllables
L26n209.description: The 'Al' or 'l' syllable inside names and split words, such as Al Alamein, Al Saud, Mevlana's 'vl', Hel-ens and Pell-agra. Pushes toward 'all', 'ell' and 'al' fragments; steered output degenerates into 'll' repeats.

L26n615.name: Place-name syllables; ancient
L26n615.description: The first syllable or capital letter of a proper name in place and history text, such as 'Lup' in Lupiac, 'P' in Pali, 'Stan' in Stanovoi and 'yll' in Phyllis. Pushes toward 'ancient', 'old' and 'antique'; steered output spams 'ancient'.

L26n1148.name: Word-start fragments; master
L26n1148.description: Word-start fragments of longer words, mostly nouns and names, such as 'bar' in barista, 'law' in lawman, 'Strateg' in strategist, 'fasc' in fasciitis and 'ma' in Taj Mahal. Pushes toward 'master' and 'Master'; steered output spams 'Master'.

L26n1143.name: Split-word starts; her
L26n1143.description: The first piece of a split word, such as 'od' in odious, 'Bal' in Balochistan, 'gr' in griddle, 'Wh' in whiskers and 'Or' in Oriskany. Pushes toward 'her', 'Her' and 'HER' tokens; steered output stutters 'Her'.

L26n1073.name: Name fragments; policy
L26n1073.description: The first 1 to 2 letters of a capitalized name, such as 'Dev' in Devi, 'Lu' in Lucrece, 'Cong' in Congaree and 'Eng' in Engaging. Pushes toward 'policy' and 'policies'; steered output spams 'Policy'.

L25n1148.name: Proper-noun openers; quote marks
L25n1148.description: The first syllable of capitalized place and person names, such as 'ver' in Averroes, 'El' in El Alamein, 'Tel' in Tel Aviv and 'Per' in Peisander. Pushes toward opening quote and bracket tokens; steered output spams quote marks.

L25n1813.name: Paths, URLs, shell syntax
L25n1813.description: Domain, path and shell-command pieces, such as '.com' and '.org' endings, '/etc', 'cd', 'sudo', 'root' and 'ALL' in sudoers lines. Pushes toward '/*' and '*/' comment markers; steered output spams them.

L26n1525.name: Superlative -est stems
L26n1525.description: The stem right before a superlative '-est' ending, such as 'jolli' in jolliest, 'dri' in driest, 'warm' in warmest and 'clean' in cleanest. Pushes toward the 'est' ending; steered output spams 'est'.

L26n58.name: Word-piece starts; negation
L26n58.description: The first 1 to 2 letters of a word split into pieces, such as 'ep' in epidermis, 'l' in lagoon, 'W' in WMO and 'p' in patty. Pushes toward negatives 'neither', 'none', 'never' and 'nothing'; steered output spams 'not' and 'neither'.

L26n336.name: Acronym openers; MC
L26n336.description: The first letter or token of an acronym, often right after an opening parenthesis, as in (MPCC), (WMO), (ISMP), (MPC) and (MCA). Pushes toward capital acronym tokens like 'MC', 'MU' and 'MB'; steered output spams 'MC'.

L25n2607.name: Name fragments; income
L25n2607.description: The first 1 to 3 letters of a place or person name, such as 'N' in Native, 'Nan' in Nanaimo, 'Nem' in Nemadji and 'Nau' in Nauvoo. Pushes toward 'income', 'gain' and 'revenue'; steered output spams 'income'.

L25n2340.name: Prefix starts; avoid
L25n2340.description: Word-start prefixes of verbs and nouns, such as 'inf' in infested, 'def' in deflection, 'dev' in deviate and 'dist' in distill. Pushes toward 'avoid' and 'prevent'; steered output spams 'avoid'.

L26n193.name: Word-start fragments; unclear
L26n193.description: Word-start fragments of longer words, such as 'g' in gobbled, 'Gate' in gatekeepers, 'Rose' in Rose Kennedy, 'show' in showy and 'Aut' in Autistic. Pushes toward closing quote and brace tokens with no clear word; steered output is weak.

L26n2323.name: Headword initials; numbers
L26n2323.description: Capital or word-start letters of headwords, such as 'F' in Filing and Families, 'Se' in severe and seawater, and 'ef' in Indefinite. Pushes toward 'numbers', 'nums' and 'numerical'; steered output spams 'numbers'.

L25n1803.name: Word before 'surface'
L25n1803.description: The modifier right before the word 'surface', such as hard level surface, flat bearing surface, gripping surface and mating surfaces. Pushes toward 'surface'; steered output spams 'surface'.

L26n2821.name: Word fragments; determined
L26n2821.description: Word-internal fragments that start a longer word, such as 'Bad' in Badlands, 'Rou' in Rouen, 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'intr' in intravascular and 'inde' in indestructible. Pushes toward 'determin', 'determine' and 'determined'; steered output spams 'determined'.

L25n1883.name: Dotted-abbreviation letters
L25n1883.description: The letter inside dotted abbreviations, such as the 'm' in a.m., 'p' in p.m., 'S' in U.S., 'C' in D.C. and 'D' in A.D. Pushes toward dot-letter tokens like '.m'; steered output spams them, as in 'I.m..s..v'.

L26n1727.name: Mid-word pieces; polynomial
L26n1727.description: Mid-word syllable pieces of longer words, such as 'er' in eroded, 'ce' in isosceles, 'Magn' in Magnificent, 'Inter' in Interferometer and 'dist' in distill. Pushes toward 'pol' and 'polynomial'; steered output spams 'pol'.

L25n486.name: Name-suffix and abbreviation pieces
L25n486.description: Fires on pieces of capitalized names and abbreviations: 'Jr' after a surname, 'Av' in Confederate Av, 'rg' in Brgoch, 'Cr' in a URL parameter, and 'Ltd' or 'Inc' after company names. Pushes toward short consonant-cluster fragments like 'mt' and 'tn'.

L25n2615.name: Chemical compound name stems
L25n2615.description: Fires inside the stem of chemical and nutrient names, such as 'methyl' in methylmercury, 'rist' in myristic, 'hydro' in dihydrotestosterone, and '-car' in beta-carotene; pushes toward 'chemical' and 'chemistry'.

L26n2170.name: Split-word fragments, 'ra' output
L26n2170.description: Fires on a middle piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'neut' in neutron, 'nit' in nitrous, 'cent' in 'recentred', or 'lect' in electrons; pushes toward word-start fragments 'r', 'ra', and 'rá'.

L26n612.name: Word pieces, comment tokens
L26n612.description: Fires on an unfinished word piece with more to come: 'oc' in tocopherol, 'trib' in tribes and tribosphenic, 'Ven' in venom, 'ecc' in ecclesiastical, 'ul' in ulcers, 'FA' in FADE IN. Pushes toward C-style comment tokens such as '//', '*/' and '/**'.

L25n1470.name: Word-continuation fragments, 'pl'
L25n1470.description: Fires on the continuation piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'multip' in multiplication, 'sup' in supposedly, or 'p' in stockpiling; pushes toward 'pl' tokens and repeated 'Pl'.

L26n2076.name: List and instruction connectives
L26n2076.description: Fires on a connective that sets up the next item in a list or instruction: 'with' after brush, cover or seal verbs, 'into', 'or' between options, 'any' after double-click, 'eg' and commas in example lists. Also fires on some word starts like 'P' in Pomeranian and 'm' in mites. Pushes toward 'goods' and 'commodities'.

L26n2189.name: Compound-term first halves
L26n2189.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer word or two-word term: 'pay' in payback period, 'phil' in philadelphus, 'Nickel' in Nickelodeon, 'solic' in solicitor, 'Golden' in Golden Retriever. Pushes toward 'back' and 'returned'.

L25n2334.name: Negative contraction stems
L25n2334.description: Fires on the stem of a negative contraction just before 't, such as 'isn' in isn't, 'couldn', 'didn', or 'weren'; pushes toward unapostrophed forms like 'didnt', 'isnt', and 'youre'.

L26n2349.name: F-initial word fragments, 'surface'
L26n2349.description: Fires on the opening letters of a split word or name, mostly 'fe', 'fl', 'fr', or 'Fr', as in Feinberg, fluoroquinolones, Franks, and fevers; pushes toward 'surface' words.

L26n591.name: Title nouns, P-words
L26n591.description: Fires on a content noun inside a title or heading list, such as 'Mental' in 'Psychiatric and Mental Health', 'Target' in 'Define Your Target Audience', or 'of' in 'Basics of Web'; pushes toward P-initial words 'Post', 'Path', and 'Pro'.

L26n2902.name: Onset fragments, 'composition' output
L26n2902.description: Fires on the consonant-cluster start of a word split into tokens, such as 'st' in stirs, 'tre' in treacherous, 'ste' in steaming, or 'bre' in Brecht; pushes toward 'composition' and 'compose'.

L26n3012.name: Name starts, 'ensure' output
L26n3012.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name split into tokens, such as 'Ju' in Juárez, 'Jo' in Joaquin, 'Ber' in beriberi, or 'Bar' in Bar Giora; pushes toward 'ensure' and 'ensuring'.

L25n923.name: Symptom word pieces, 'dry'
L25n923.description: Fires on a single piece of a symptom, animal, or plant word, such as 'sne' in sneezing, 'seaw' in seaweed, 'z' in zoonotic, or 'o' in oaks; pushes toward 'dry', 'wet', and 'moist'.

L26n2119.name: Word before 'value'
L26n2119.description: Fires on the adjective or noun right before a 'value', 'potential', or 'benefits' noun, such as 'time' in time value of money, 'nutritional' in nutritional value, or 'academic' in academic potential; pushes toward 'value' and 'worth'.

L26n1465.name: Capital U of U.S.
L26n1465.description: Fires on the capital 'U' that opens 'U.S.' after 'the' (the U.S. Department, the U.S. Geological Survey), and on 'U' in UCLA and Uffizi. Pushes toward 'fun' and 'func' tokens.

L26n2203.name: Name fragments, 'conclusion' output
L26n2203.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or split word, such as 'Sus' in Susilo, 'Jud' in Judah, 'Dis' in Disraeli, 'fo' in foal, or '-br' in blood-brain; pushes toward 'conclusion' and 'result'.

L25n1052.name: Proper-noun middle pieces
L25n1052.description: Fires on a middle piece of a capitalized name split into several tokens: 'ule' in Suleiman, 'ut' in Sutak, 'Serg' in Sergipe, 'Riv' in Riviera, 'Hil' in Hilfiger. Pushes toward 'stage' and 'phase'.

L26n1035.name: Onset fragments f/fl/bl
L26n1035.description: Fires on a short f or b onset (fl, f, bl, br) that starts the unfinished second piece of a word: 'fl' in flowering and flanged, 'f' in fables, 'bl' in bladder, 'br' in brave. Pushes toward 'benefit' and 'advantage'.

L26n2102.name: Later name pieces
L26n2102.description: Fires on an unfinished later piece of a split name or word: 'amb' in Rambouillet and Bambang, 'Mand' in Mandeb, 'row' in Woodrow, 'spe' in asparagus spears, 'tre' in treble, 'inated' in polychlorinated. Pushes toward 'dec' tokens.

L25n1855.name: Capitalized word-start fragments
L25n1855.description: Fires on an unfinished word or name piece, usually capitalized: 'hyper' in hyperacusis, 'Ch' in Chhattisgarh and Chakma, 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'Kh' in Khadur, 'Tr' in Trang. Pushes toward comma-quote tuple tokens.

L26n2375.name: Split-word opening fragments
L26n2375.description: Fires on the first one or two letters of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'P' in Polar, 'po' in poached, 'p' in puffling; points the model toward 'exercise'.

L26n1018.name: Line-end word (negative)
L26n1018.description: Negative on the last word of a list item or label, just before a line break or period (e.g. 'deficiency', 'site', 'answers'); its output points to closing quote tokens.

L25n2611.name: Word fragments, dress words
L25n2611.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens (e.g. 'cuis' in cuisines, 'ec' in ecologic, 'w' in wobbling) and on dress and outfit words; points toward 'theme(s)'.

L26n2631.name: Word-start 'm' and 'P'
L26n2631.description: Fires on a one-letter 'm' or 'P' that opens a split word, mostly mid-sentence (e.g. 'm' in mucus, 'Verm' in vermilion, 'P' in PLOS); points toward 'teacher(s)'.

L25n2029.name: Digits inside numbers
L25n2029.description: Fires on a digit within a multi-digit number, usually the first or second digit with more digits still to come (e.g. '2' in -286, '9' in 1982, '8' in 1,098 km); points toward 'middle' and 'mid'.

L26n1952.name: Mid-name fragments (negative)
L26n1952.description: Negative on a middle piece of a name or long word split into tokens (e.g. 'pr' in jurisprudence, 'vl' in Mevlana, 'Bl' in Blasco); its output points to 'opinion' and 'debate'.

L26n1343.name: Mid-word fragment, writes 'total'
L26n1343.description: Negative on a non-initial fragment of a split name or word (e.g. 'Sum' in Sumner, 'cor' in coracoid, 'tom' in tomography); its output points to 'total'.

L26n406.name: Mid-word fragment, writes 'not'
L26n406.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of a split word (e.g. 'reg' in reggae, 'Ram' in Rambla, 'chrom' in chromosomal); its output points to negation words 'not', 'no' and 'nicht'.

L25n733.name: URL scheme 'https'
L25n733.description: Negative on the 'http' or 'https' token that opens a web address (e.g. 'curl https', 'https://www'); its output points to colon tokens such as '::' and ':'.

L26n1593.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'js/css'
L26n1593.description: Fires on a short opening piece of a name or word split into tokens (e.g. 'mel' in melons, 'Sol' in Solon, 'Gl' in glowing); its output points to code tokens 'js' and 'css'.

L26n2312.name: Pores and cavities
L26n2312.description: Fires on the structure word in anatomy and botany descriptions (e.g. 'tiny' pores, 'seed' boxes, 'carp' in carpels, 'lymph' in lymphatic); its output points to 'holes', 'cavity' and 'chambers'.

L25n3069.name: Word stem before suffix
L25n3069.description: Negative on the stem piece of a word that continues into a suffix or second piece (e.g. 'ex' in exposed, 'rip' in ripe, 'semi' in semi-transparent, 'Russ' in Russians); its output points to 'exposure'.

L26n895.name: Capital letter, name opener
L26n895.description: Fires on the short first piece of a capitalised name or noun, often a single letter (e.g. 'D' in Dahi, 'U' in U.S., 'z' in zucchini); its output points to '=' and 'equals'.

L26n2382.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'shot'
L26n2382.description: Negative on the opening piece of a split word (e.g. 'fl' in outflank, 'em' in emerald, 'cal' in calici, 'inter' in interstitials); its output points to 'shot' and 'shoot'.

L26n1155.name: Digit or hyphen prefix
L26n1155.description: Fires on the digit that starts a quantity or on the prefix before a hyphen (e.g. '1' in 1/4 cup, '4' in 4x4 keypad, '-f' in three-forked); its output points to 'tab' words.

L25n2839.name: Word fragment, writes 'keep'
L25n2839.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split word (e.g. 'ont' in strontium, 'ydro' in hydrogen, 'orth' in orthotic); its output points to 'keep' and 'keeping'.

L26n1304.name: Con-word opener (negative)
L26n1304.description: Negative on the 'Con', 'con' or 'Cor' opening piece of a word or name (e.g. 'constit' in constituting, 'Con' in conventional, 'Cor' in Coral); its output points to participles like 'resulting', 'leading' and 'remaining'.

L26n2260.name: Government names, climate policy
L26n2260.description: Negative on a name or title in US government and climate-policy news (e.g. the 's' in Obama's, 'President', 'federal', 'GG' in RGGI); its output points to 'environmental' and 'ecological'.

L26n577.name: Fiction and film words
L26n577.description: Fires on fiction and film genre words (e.g. 'fiction' in science fiction, '-fi' in sci-fi, 'Scissorhands', 'video game'); its output points to 'film' and 'movie'.

L26n1474.name: Name and technical middles
L26n1474.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split name or technical word (e.g. 'bre' in Albrecht, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'fasc' in fasciitis, 'gl' in glomerular); its output points to 'out' and 'outcome'.

L25n1333.name: Split-word starts lo/qu
L25n1333.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split word, mostly 'lo' and 'qu' (locket, quasar, quinoa, Lo-), also 'wal' and '-pro'; pushes the model toward 'offer/offering'.

L26n1745.name: Identity and group terms
L26n1745.description: Strongly negative on identity and group-label words: LGBT, gay, racial, ethnic, gender, race, national identity, and phrases like 'identified as' or 'no longer identify'. Pushes toward 'identify' and 'identified'.

L26n2790.name: Split-word opening piece
L26n2790.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split across tokens when that piece is not yet a word (Sup|pressed, gre|ening, intr|avenous, Jun|o, top|ological, Per|itoneal). Pushes toward 'seat' and 'seats'.

L25n1399.name: Newlines and word starts
L25n1399.description: Goes strongly negative on word-initial fragments (thr-, und-, nod-, gr-, Bl-) and on the newline before a heading like 'Memo' or 'FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE'; pushing it negative makes the model emit endless newlines.

L25n757.name: Hyper- and stem fragments
L25n757.description: Fires on word-internal stems split by the tokenizer, notably 'hyper' (hyperacusis, hyperparameters, hypermethylation), 'adul' in adulterated and 'bas' in basal; pushes toward '-able/ability'.

L26n1871.name: Capitalized opening fragment
L26n1871.description: Fires on the capitalized first piece of a name or word split across tokens (T|iberius, Th|orns, Th|elypteridaceae, St|alingrad, Te|es), and on 'cal' in 'calici'. Pushes toward 'necessary' and 'essential'.

L26n1489.name: Prefix fragments
L26n1489.description: Fires on the 2-4 letter opening or middle piece of a split word, not on whole words (eig|envectors, sequ|enced, flu|encer, erg|enic, equival|ently). Pushes toward 'engagement' and 'encoding'.

L25n2730.name: Short E/cad opening fragment
L25n2730.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letter piece of a split word, often a capital 'E' or 'cad' (E|ars, E|uphrates, cad|mium, enc|roachment, phen|omena). Pushes toward 'fall' and 'falls'.

L25n101.name: Period after speaker tag
L25n101.description: Strongly negative on the period that closes a speaker tag ('she noted.', 'Cameron said.') right before a quoted sentence, plus words inside quotes such as 'Imagine' and 'beginning'. Pushes toward closing quote marks.

L26n345.name: Digits inside big numbers
L26n345.description: Fires on a single digit in the middle of a comma-grouped number (the 5 in 157,000, the 9 in 115,391), mostly in population and money figures; pushing it toward full-width punctuation ('，', '：') and junk tokens.

L26n2735.name: Protein name before factor
L26n2735.description: Fires on the first word or word piece of a biology term that precedes 'factor' or 'hormone' (transcription, growth, cytokine, releasing), strongest on 'transcription' and 'growth', and on 'Coll' in collagen. Pushes toward 'factor' and 'factory'.

L26n2814.name: Negative 're-' word starts
L26n2814.description: Goes strongly negative on word-initial 're' or 'Bre/wre/rem' fragments of split words (re|connection, Re|combination, rem|embrance, Bre|athing); pushing it negative steers toward 'combine/combination'.

L25n745.name: URL scheme and digits
L25n745.description: Fires on 'http' and 'https' at the start of a URL, on the first piece of split words (phot|ovoltaic, ozo|ne), and on digits in clock times such as 3:20 or 8:30. Pushes toward code closers like ]: and ):.

L26n1965.name: rec/er/m opening pieces
L26n1965.description: Fires on short opening pieces of split words, mainly 'rec' (rec|eded, rec|ollections), 'er' (er|oded, Er|win) and 'm' (newly-m|inted, m|ementos), mid-sentence; whole words stay low. Pushes toward 'walk' and 'walking'.

L26n1866.name: Extent and outcome words
L26n1866.description: Fires on extent adjectives (absolute, partial, generalized) and on the preposition or verb that sets up an outcome or state (result in, reduced to, threatened with, take over). Pushes toward 'complete' and 'total'.

L26n256.name: Naming construction (called)
L26n256.description: Strongly negative on the word that introduces a name or label (called, known as, the word, genus, named), just before the name itself (is called an abscess, the genus Diaptomus, the word khamba). Steering produces code and markdown noise.

L26n1968.name: Word-start 'in/un' prefixes
L26n1968.description: Fires on the first fragment of words starting 'ind', 'inc', 'und' or 'ha' (induced, incision, undeniably, hairstyles), before the stem arrives; pushes toward 'union/unions'.

L26n2243.name: dec and mal pieces
L26n2243.description: Fires on the short opening pieces 'dec' and 'mal' of split words (dec|arbonising, dec|oupling, Mal|oney), with weaker firing on 'dosing' and 'fertilized' suffix pieces. Pushes toward 'process' and 'procedure'.

L26n1543.name: Modifier before technical noun
L26n1543.description: Fires on the adjective or first word of a fixed technical compound, before its head noun (Large| Hadron, square| matrix, second|-order, grass| verge, Word|Net). Pushes toward 'root'.

L25n1583.name: Number words, place-name starts
L25n1583.description: Goes strongly negative on number words (Three, Two, Seven, eight, ten) and the first piece of ethnonyms or place names (Therm-opylae, Ber-ber, Kass-ites, Bant-us); pushing it negative makes the model repeat 'city'.

L26n449.name: Dots and closing punctuation
L26n449.description: Fires on diffuse word fragments and on the <think> token that opens an assistant turn in chat. Pushes toward '...' and closing punctuation such as '）。', '**:' and '”。', and steering spams dots.

L26n28.name: Intensifier before a noun
L26n28.description: Fires on the intensifier or evaluative adjective ('significant', 'greatly', 'profound', 'critical') that sits between 'a' or 'has' and its noun in the opening line of a chat answer. The written tokens ('Empresa', '+E') carry no clear meaning, and steering gives only mild drift.

L26n841.name: Mid-word fragment before continuation
L26n841.description: Goes negative on the first or middle subword piece of a word split across tokens, just before the rest of the word (Da|ughters, Veter|inarians, Č|ačić, Del|phians). Pushes toward garbled fragments like 'loom', 'glich' and 'hlen', and steering spams them.

L26n1979.name: w/ow word splits
L26n1979.description: Goes negative on short 'w', 'ow', 'Char' and 'Sw' fragments inside split words (bi|ow|arfare, hard|w|ired, Ship|w|reck). Pushes toward 'equality', 'inequality' and 'equation' tokens, and steering spams 'equality'.

L26n1777.name: Overflow and filling context
L26n1777.description: Fires on the word just before a containment or overflow predicate ('that', 'should', 'will', 'to') and on fluid or filling nouns (eff|usion, molten alloy) in text about overflow, effusion or filling. Pushes toward 'fill', 'fills' and 'filling'.

L25n1380.name: Split-name first pieces
L25n1380.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly place names (Marr|akesh, Có|rdoba) and 'miss' in misspelled or misspelling. Pushes toward 'sp' fragments, and steering spams 'Sp sp'.

L26n1318.name: Short word-start h fragment
L26n1318.description: Goes negative on a bare 'h' or other short prefix that opens a split word (h|edges, h|ump, self-h|arm, h|awthorn). Pushes toward quality nouns like 'accuracy', 'correctness', 'reliability' and 'simplicity'.

L26n559.name: Verbs of expressing feeling
L26n559.description: Fires on the verb or auxiliary that follows a feeling subject in letters, cards and essays ('expresses', 'expressing', 'feels', 'am', 'were'). Pushes toward 'national', 'country' and 'nation', and steering spams 'National'.

L25n1826.name: M-file and script tokens
L25n1826.description: Fires on the 'M' or '.m' token that names a MATLAB file (M-file, simple.m) and on 'script' or 'file' in code instructions. Pushes toward 'file', 'files' and 'File', and steering spams 'file file'.

L26n1077.name: Function word before verbs
L26n1077.description: Goes negative on a function word that introduces an action verb ('to', 'can', 'will', 'then') in instructions and explanations ('then deletes', 'can just type'). Pushes toward 'list' and 'List' tokens, and steering spams 'list'.

L26n2238.name: Split-name middle pieces
L26n2238.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split proper name or word (Az|alea, Maz|aheri, Dol|aucothi, Bol|ivian). Pushes toward a capital 'Z', and steering spams 'Z Z'.

L26n773.name: Second word of titles
L26n773.description: Goes negative on the second word of a capitalized title or institution (Emancipation Proclamation, Working Class, Constitutional Convention, Public Education). Pushes toward first-person pronouns 'My', 'We' and 'Me', and steering spams 'My'.

L26n1633.name: Mid-word technical fragments
L26n1633.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a long technical word or name split into tokens (electrom|yography, metam|orphosis, elect|rophoresis, kin|ases). Pushes toward 'header' tokens, and steering spams 'date header'.

L26n180.name: Free and outside modifiers
L26n180.description: Goes negative on a modifier right before its head noun in fixed phrases, strongest on 'free' in 'free verse poem' prompts and also on 'outside the class' and 'age group'. Pushes toward '/' tokens, and steering spams '/ / /'.

L26n2231.name: Quantity before measured amount
L26n2231.description: Fires on a number or 'a few' right before a measure in recipes and home remedies ('add 1/4 cup', 'add 1 cup', '5/50 mixture'). Pushes toward the unit 'drop' and 'drops', and steering spams 'drop drop'.

L26n2924.name: Rare-name later pieces
L26n2924.description: Fires on a later piece of a rare name or word split into several tokens (Bort|ny|ik, Mack|inac, Rab|ag|lia, Ath|ab|asca, th|iam|ine). Pushes toward 'lines' and 'line', and steering spams 'lines lines'.

L25n1387.name: Colon/newline before code
L25n1387.description: Fires on a colon or line break that ends an intro line before code, a list or an example ('like:' then newline, 'Here's one possible solution:'). Pushes toward code keywords 'else', 'while', 'try' and 'raise', and steering spams 'While while'.

L25n832.name: sh/Ch onsets, decimal 0
L25n832.description: Fires on an opening 'sh', 'Sh', 'Ch' or 'Ph' fragment of a split word (sh|ut, Ch|ilton, sh|roud) and on a leading '0' or '1' before decimal digits (0|.05). Pushes toward '=' plus a letter such as '=q', and steering spams 'light:'.

L26n2332.name: Mid-word fragment in names
L26n2332.description: Goes negative on a middle fragment of a long proper noun or word split into tokens (Ne|op|latonic, Nau|v|oo, Hiroshima Peace, epi|psy|lepsy). Pushes toward 'subset', 'series' and 'Set' tokens.

L25n1294.name: Noun-phrase and name openers
L25n1294.description: Goes negative on the word that opens a noun phrase or name ('Resources' in World Resources Institute, 'Pope' in Pope Francis, 'Studies', 'pro' in prokaryotes). Pushes toward 'dream', 'dreams' and 'predictions', and steering spams 'dreams'.

L26n2134.name: Intensifiers and 'stay'
L26n2134.description: Degree adverbs and 'stay' right before an adjective or verb (absolutely, relatively, almost, completely, 'stay' in 'stay hydrated'); pushes toward risk, stress, trouble and disease nouns.

L25n2371.name: Split name fragments; brace
L25n2371.description: Later pieces of proper names split into tokens (Ban in Ban Ki-moon, Pan in Arvind Pan, Dor in Dorset, ior in Giora); pushes toward '{', the JSON opening brace.

L26n2805.name: Mid-word fragments; machine
L26n2805.description: The middle piece of a rare word split into tokens (ang|ina, tantr|ic, gar|uda, ang|ered, fully-g|rown); pushes toward 'machine'.

L25n1954.name: Word-start fragments; allocate
L25n1954.description: Fires negatively on the opening piece of split words, often 'di' (archdiocese, dihydrotestosterone), 'Arist' (Aristotelian), 'Educational' and 'scientific'; pushes toward 'allocate'.

L25n2120.name: Shape and size words
L25n2120.description: Fires negatively on geometry and measurement words ('square', 'rectangles', 'polygon', 'closed', 'nano', 'milli') and the '2' in '2-by-4' lumber; pushes toward 'square'.

L26n2470.name: Word stems before suffixes
L26n2470.description: A stem fragment of a longer word split into tokens, just before its ending (suff|used, cons|cription, res|istance, odef|iciency); pushes toward 'record'.

L26n2710.name: Opening 'wh'/'sw' fragments
L26n2710.description: Word-opening fragments 'wh', 'sw' and 'unw' split off from the rest of the word (whizzes, whiten, Whiskers, swallowing, swimmers); pushes toward 'sensitive' and 'sensitivity'.

L26n2627.name: Word-internal fragments; hand
L26n2627.description: A middle fragment of a word split across tokens (pamph|leteer, inf|irm, leg|ia, Br|ave, Pr|ize); pushes toward 'hand' and 'hands'.

L26n2963.name: Noun modifiers before head
L26n2963.description: A noun or adjective that modifies a following head noun (horn in horned lizard, back in backyard, front in frontline, command in command area); pushes toward 'post' and 'blog'.

L26n2225.name: Proper-name starts; lack
L26n2225.description: The first fragment of a capitalized place or person name split into tokens (Ch in Chaco, La in La Verne, Que in Queensland, Z in Zulu); pushes toward 'lack', 'missing' and 'absence'.

L26n247.name: '(' before an acronym
L26n247.description: Fires negatively on an opening '(' that introduces an acronym or abbreviation (ERA, K–12, BTC, IDEA, ASD); pushes toward uppercase letter tokens.

L25n1629.name: Percent and rate numbers
L25n1629.description: The number or 'Annual' right before a percent sign or rate term ('6.5%', '11%', 'Annual Percentage Rates'); pushes toward '%'.

L25n1723.name: Account and login nouns
L25n1723.description: The determiner or noun just before 'account' ('an' in 'deposit into an account') plus login, bank and registration words; pushes toward 'account' and 'accounts'.

L25n1372.name: Determiners before 'book'
L25n1372.description: Fires negatively on a determiner or possessive ('his', 'this', 'the', 's' in Frankl's) right before a noun for a book, course, report or guide; pushes toward 'book'.

L26n1469.name: Word starts: Wh, Suc
L26n1469.description: Fires negatively on the first piece of a split capitalized word or chemical name ('Wh' in Whittingham, 'Suc' in sucralose, 'Sw' in Swindon); pushes toward 'short' and 'shorter'.

L25n2861.name: Adverse-effect adjectives
L25n2861.description: Fires negatively on the word just before 'effects', 'problems' or 'symptoms' that names an adverse outcome ('serious', 'severe', 'fatal', 'potential', 'common', 'cause'); pushes toward 'side'.

L26n1466.name: Surname starts; men
L26n1466.description: The first fragment of a capitalized personal or club name split into tokens (Mos in Moses, Kos, Roth, Luc, Sk in Skutnabb); pushes toward 'men', 'man' and 'boys'.

L25n2017.name: Word-initial 'h'
L25n2017.description: A word-initial 'h' split off as its own piece (h|orticulture, h|awthorn, h|edges, h|ives, h|atching); pushes toward 'home' and 'hom' tokens.

L26n2729.name: Mid-name fragments; zip
L26n2729.description: Fires negatively on a middle piece of a long proper or technical word split into tokens (Kwa-Zu-lu-Natal, Sk-op-je, Gu-ineensis, Mp-um-alanga); pushes toward 'zip' and 'z'.

L25n438.name: Digits in number runs
